note: This file contains only data — two lists of template definitions (DIG_WITH_CORRECTION and DIG_TEMPLATES) composed of symbolic TemplateObject references. There are no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It is a pure data/configuration file used by the DROIDlet semantic parsing system to generate natural language utterances for the 'Dig' action in a Minecraft-like environment.
DIG_TEMPLATES: list of template definitions for generating natural language dig commands covering location, shape, dimensions, size, repeat count, and conditions
DIG_WITH_CORRECTION: list of correction template pairs for generating corrected dig commands with new location specifications
